title: Strict Neumann Polya inequality on simply connected planar domains
abstract: A Lean 4 / Mathlib formalization of the strict Neumann Pólya inequality for bounded simply connected Lipschitz domains in the plane. The plane is identified with ℂ; the Neumann eigenvalues μ_0 ≤ μ_1 ≤ ... are defined by the Courant–Fischer min–max formula for the form ∫|∇u|² on H¹(Ω) (weak gradients in L²), indexed from 0 and repeated according to multiplicity, and N_N(E) = #{j ≥ 0 : μ_j < E}. The principal results are: for every bounded simply connected Lipschitz domain Ω and every integer j ≥ 1, |Ω| μ_j(Ω) < 4πj; and, equivalently, N_N(E) > |Ω| E / (4π) for every E > 0. The proof development (about 100,000 lines, namespace PolyaNeumann) also identifies the variational eigenvalues with the spectrum of the constructed self-adjoint Neumann operator, proves a quantitative smooth-domain estimate via boundary transport, Cayley/monodromy rank bounds and a Herglotz-wave reduction, and passes to Lipschitz domains by smooth approximation.
